environment.fonts: same fonts/assets loaded; do not compare fallbacks

fixtures.policy: Synthetic isolated account/session/mail outbox/round fixtures, independent reference/candidate datasets; no real emails, passwords, tokens or survey answers in screenshots/logs. Mask password inputs normally, never dump auth payload. Resolve IDs/tokens inside authorized future test only.
fixtures.conditional_rounds: cover optional earlier deadline followed by mandatory, postergable, closed, expired, already answered, not segmented and anonymous response

inactive.account: inactive synthetic account; no pre-existing session

web_disabled.account: active synthetic account with acceso_web=False; no pre-existing session

initial_expired.account: active, acceso_web=True, must_change_password=True, initial_password_expires_at before frozen clock

password_pending.account: active, acceso_web=True, must_change_password=True, initial password not expired

profile_pending.account: active, acceso_web=True, password resolved, profile confirmation pending

profile_and_survey.account: active, acceso_web=True, password resolved, profile and mandatory survey pending

optional_then_mandatory.rounds: segmented optional with earlier deadline, mandatory with later deadline

fixtures.reset_subject: Separate active synthetic account and test-only mailbox; never send real email; temporary token generated only in authorized future test, never saved to artifacts.

contract_cases.expected: Missing/invalid CSRF rejected before login; no reliance on anonymous SessionAuthentication
Login/session rotation and CSRF correctly followed without stale cookie or private cache
Static upstream receives only clean index/assets, no reset uid/token/next/query/user cookie
Second use invalid after password changed; state reflects backend token checks
Custom reset explicit Token deletion and profile cleanup preserved; no assumption about untested signals
Do not unify forms/flags/revocation; test their distinct backend effects
Payload cannot alter another user/groups/permissions/scopes/delegation/flags
Segmented ordinary user may respond without Change/View survey administration
Response user=None when anonymous, compliance separate; do not expose linkable answer identity
Later invalid question leaves no partial response
Backend compliance/transaction rejects duplicate; no automatic retry when response lost
Mandatory cannot postpone/discard; optional cannot postpone; nonsegmented/closed/expired reject
Safe host/scheme and fallback according to source; no arbitrary redirect
No replay after relogin; reconcile whether mutation happened
No management exception may bypass disabled access/password/profile requirements
Change allows exception to survey block, never grants Publish/Approve/Export permission missing from route/service
Approve without Change does not get legacy Change exception while mandatory survey pending
When ready, keep original Approve permission; do not add Change universally to approval
Change survey does not allow Insumos/VAT/users/PAS business while blocked by survey
Access state stays mandatory_survey; no false ready or clearing compliance required

candidate_entry_policy: Scoped same public paths after authorized activation; static index request never contains uid/reset token/next/private query
